data.name: AlBarsis
data.gender_notes: AlBarsis is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'as-b-r' meaning 'lion'. AlBarsis is a name of strength and courage in Islam, evoking the image of a noble and powerful lion. The name AlBarsis carries the meaning “The Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlBarsis usually hope their child will grow to embody the lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of bravery and nobility, inspiring those who bear the name to be strong and courageous in their faith and daily life.
data.etymology: AlBarsis belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlBarsis total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: البرسيس
in_arabic.meaning: البرسيس اسم يعني الشخص القوي والشجاع في المعارك
in_arabic.long_meaning: البرسيس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص القوي والشجاع في المعارك، ويتميز بالقدرة على التغلب على الصعوبات. وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير أنه مشتق من البرس الذي هو القوة والشجاعة.

in_urdu.name: البریس
in_urdu.meaning: البریس ایک ایسا نام ہے جو کسی مضبوط اور بہادر شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: البریس ایک عربی मूल کا مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کسی مضبوط اور بہادر شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو معرکوں میں شجاعت دکھاتا ہے۔ اس نام کی اصطلاحی روایت کے مطابق، یہ نام القوۃ اور الشجاعۃ کی معانی سے منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलबर्सीस
in_hindi.meaning: अलबर्सीस एक ऐसा नाम है जो किसी मजबूत और बहादुर व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग होता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलबर्सीस एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है किसी मजबूत और बहादुर व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग होता है जो युद्धों में वीरता दिखाता है। इस नाम की व्युत्पत्ति के अनुसार, यह नाम बल और साहस के अर्थों से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: البرسیس
in_pashto.meaning: البرسیس د قوي او زړور سړي لپاره کارول کيږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: البرسیس د عربي اصل مذکر نوم دی چې معنی يې د قوي او زړور سړي لپاره کارول کيږي څوک چې په جګړو کې زړورتيا ښيي. ددې نوم د رېښو له مخې، دا نوم د قوت او زړورتيا د مفهومونو سره تړاو لري.

data.cultural_impact: The name AlBarsis in the Islamic culture carries a deep sense of respect and reverence. Lions have held a significant place in Islamic art, literature, and folklore for centuries. AlBarsis is a reminder of the strength, bravery, and fearlessness that Muslims are encouraged to embody. This name is often given to boys to instill in them the qualities of a mighty and honorable lion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name AlBarsis also holds spiritual significance in Islam. It is a reminder of the power and courage that the belief in Allah (God) gives us as Muslims. Hearing this name may inspire a sense of pride in one's faith and a deep connection to the divine. It is a reminder that, like a lion, we have the strength to face the challenges of life and the courage to stand up for what is right. Furthermore, the name AlBarsis may evoke images of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), who is likened to a lion due to his unwavering strength and courage in the face of adversity. Overall, AlBarsis is a powerful and inspiring name, both culturally and spiritually.
